selection.rule: Sort all cat=kernel, ph=X events by ts. Find the first whose uniquely correlation-matched CUDA launch API interval is fully contained in the CPU annotation topic02_decode_7_steps. Retain that kernel and the next seven consecutive physical kernels. Assert all eight matched API intervals are contained in the same annotation.
selection.time_origin: Start of earliest retained event (first matched CPU launch); all timestamps are relative, in microseconds.
selection.join: Unique args.correlation match between each kernel and cuda_runtime/cuda_driver launch API; original identifiers omitted.
selection.numeric_rounding: Six decimal places in microseconds; display should round further. Precision is not accuracy.

limits: This is the start of one profiled decode region, not a representative random sample or an unprofiled latency measurement.
The CPU annotation labels submitted work; its boundaries are not synchronized GPU boundaries. Membership is established through matched launch APIs.
API intervals and GPU kernels can overlap and are not additive time buckets.
Time outside these recorded kernels does not by itself establish idle GPU time or identify a CPU bottleneck. Other categories, processes and profiler overhead are outside this claim.
Short labels abbreviate exact kernel symbol names retained in name; they are not a complete semantic reconstruction of the model.
Only allowlisted names, relative times and hash provenance are published. No raw timestamps, paths, PID/TID, host metadata or original correlation IDs are included.
